source_full_text: And he would not say it. The king heard of this and was very angry, and sent for the shepherd to appear before him. The shepherd came and stood before the throne, Where the king sat looking very grand and powerful. But however grand or powerful he might be the shepherd did not feel a bit afraid of him. Say at once,
